channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Calculate It
item.description: A roguelike where you build your own calculator. Buy unusual buttons, combine them with passive upgrades, and reach target numbers while saving turns and charges. Defeat bosses that change the rules and unlock new possibilities for future runs.

item.title: It Has My Face
item.description: IT HAS YOUR FACE. Now it wants your life. Hide, seek, and try to kill your clone in this deceptively simple first-person horror roguelite.

item.title: No Such Place
item.description: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

item.title: Valve Index® Controllers
item.description: Your hands, in VR.Valve Index Controllers have been designed from the ground up to enable natural input, high fidelity hand presence, and comfort in VR.Half-Life: AlyxHalf-Life: Alyx is yours, whether you've had your Valve Index for a while, or are just about to take the plunge.

item.title: Valve Index® Headset
item.description: [h1]Fidelity First.[/h1]With fidelity as a priority, the Valve Index Headset delivers on all fronts.[columnset][column]Displays.Custom displays feature high resolution visuals with accurate colors across a high frame rate.Optics.

item.title: Valve Index® Replacement Tether
item.description: If your headset is still under warranty, contact Steam Support before purchasing replacement parts.

item.title: Allogloom
item.description: Join Nora in this mysterious and macabre point and click adventure game. Find and collect items to solve puzzles. Talk to peculiar people and monsters alike. Explore Gruesome Grove and beyond to uncover forgotten truths and save the people of her town!

item.title: Deep Dish Dungeon
item.description: A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.

item.title: Double Dealers
item.description: A 3–6 player auction game built around bluffing, deception, and manipulation, where you must outsmart your opponents in tense bidding wars, hide the truth, and turn risky trades into profit. Every round is a battle of mind games where trust is fragile and strategy decides the winner.

item.title: Hungry Horrors
item.description: Hungry Horrors is a story-driven deckbuilder set in the folklore of the British Isles. Cook real traditional dishes, chain flavour synergies, meet mythical characters, and feed legendary Horrors before they feed on you.

item.title: Legion Was Here
item.description: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.

item.title: Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith
item.description: Run your own dwarven forge. Craft legendary gear, enchant your creations with elven magic, and hire a crew of goblin workers to keep the forge running. Then arm the heroes of the realm and send them into dungeons for loot and gold. The forge beckons!

item.title: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me
item.description: A melancholic first-person adventure through a dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Explore, encounter its strange inhabitants, and solve puzzles as you unravel a story about the fragility of existence.

item.title: Nidhogg
item.description: Nidhogg is the epic award-winning game of fencing tug-of-war complete with flying giant worms.

item.title: Papa's Freezeria Deluxe
item.description: Return to Calypso Island to serve seasonal sundae treats in Papa's Freezeria Deluxe! Craft sundaes in the Freezeria for all your quirky customers while earning tips, points and Special Recipes. Switch gears and take a trip in the Food Truck to concoct your own chilly creations and see who shows up!

item.title: Poly Fighter
item.description: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with beginner-friendly controls to master your moveset and claim your title!

item.title: Roguefort
item.description: An open-world roguelike RPG where magic comes from cheesemaking. Explore a living continent, join Guilds, crawl dungeons, build a homestead and sail with friends. Or start a settlement in Fortress mode and manage its people, farms and workshops.

item.title: Trash Day
item.description: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure for up to 6 players. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen wagon, and haul it to Raccoon Paradise. Live your best raccoon life.

item.title: Chef Life: A Restaurant Simulator
item.description: Create and manage your dream restaurant! Menus, purchasing, décor, staff, equipment, customers… and don't forget the actual cooking! Experience the daily life of a restaurateur and earn your awards from the Michelin Guide.

item.title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza - Cooking Simulator Game
item.description: Ready to settle in with a soothing shift behind the counter? Feel the dough, hear the quiet crackle of the oven, and serve warm slices to grateful guests. Good Pizza, Great Pizza is the cozy, asmr-friendly escape you didn’t know you kneaded.

item.title: HYPERFIGHT 2
item.description: Your meter is your life. Use it wisely or risk it all in this brand-new take on 2D fighting. This is the next evolution of HYPERFIGHT!

item.title: Legion Breaker
item.description: Legion Breaker is an active incremental game about growing a novice wizard into an unstoppable battlemage. Unlock powerful spells, raise a holy army, and crush undead hordes across expanding battlefields on your way to the Necromancer King.

item.title: The Chef's Shift
item.description: The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING.

item.title: They Are Billions
item.description: They Are Billions is a Steampunk strategy game set on a post-apocalyptic planet. Build and defend colonies to survive against the billions of the infected that seek to annihilate the few remaining living humans. Can humanity survive after the zombie apocalypse?

item.title: Voidtrain - Big Catch
item.description: Catch fish aboard your train, upgrade your gear, and earn Scales with every catch to spend on fishing upgrades and train decor.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!

item.title: Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack
item.description: A new weapon and playable species have landed in Rotwood! Join the Drakin and use their fabled Greatsword to conquer the woods and fight back against the vicious Drakinspawn.

item.title: MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries
item.description: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.
